subject: Demo Day: Credit allocation request for Orchard Founders Cohort

To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Demo Day credits for Orchard Founders Cohort

Hi Rachel,

We run the Orchard Founders Cohort (35 early-stage teams) and are finalizing benefits for our demo day on Aug 2. A handful of our startups are already experimenting with LLMs and asked if we could include Redwood credits as a cohort benefit to help them build demo prototypes.

Can Redwood provide a cohort credit allocation (we're thinking an aggregate ~ $8k-$12k equivalent) that startups can claim self-serve? If possible we'd like eligibility to be limited to Orchard portfolio companies and require a short verification step (company domain + demo-day registration).

What info do you need from us to evaluate? We can send roster + company links and expected timeframe (60–90 days post-issuance).

Thanks — appreciate any fast path since promo materials go out next week.

Best,
Amy Park
Program Director, Orchard VC
amy@orchardvc.com

Hi Amy — thanks for reaching out, love the cohort.

We can usually do a cohort grant that startups claim through a short self-serve flow that verifies domain + event registration. To help us size and fast-track approval, can you send:
- cohort roster (company name + domain + primary contact)
- approximate expected monthly token usage per team (range is fine)
- preferred credit expiry (we typically do 6 months; we can extend to 9 in special cases)

I'll attach a one-page request form to capture these quickly. If you can send the roster and a point person, I’ll put this through the promo approvals queue and loop in our pricing lead.
